source_policy: 新档项目生命周期规则，替换早期死亡等回城才保存的草案；旧schema1～4仍严格拒0HP，不把新规则倒用到坏旧档。

validation.active: HP integer1..valid current max; pending_death null
validation.awaiting_respawn: HP exactly0; one valid pending_death record; all active command permissions off; no ticking battle entity for that character
validation.missing_life_state: reject new-schema record, never infer active from a positive number
validation.conflict: activeHP0 or awaiting_respawnHP>0/null death record rejected, no automatic heal/respawn

death_event_id_unique: within character committed revision chain; same lethal root cannot produce2death settlements
on_death: first complete configured interception; if not intercepted atomically HP0+awaiting_respawn+death receipt+activity failure/resource effects. Cancel root input/accepted future attack emissions according to death rules, clear death-cleared chord/rage/shield/charge. Preserve actual inventory/XP/currency/quest/claim rights/cooldowns. Do not grant22pack or rewind paid items.
posthumous_effects: only already committed standalone world status effects that owner contracts allow remain under persisted original source IDs; they cannot revive attacker or resume its cancelled action. Unemitted offensive child hits cancelled once. Source ID need not live node.
death_page: no gameplay move/attack/skill/loot/shop; settings/chat/save allowed; explicit respawn choice. LAN other actors/world continue; offline death page pauses as modal. Save and return to selector do not silently respawn.
ordinary_save: persist death fixed-step result and current final revision immediately when possible; prior ordinary save-waits-action requirement does not wait forever for a cancelled dead action. On failure retain old file and committed dead memory/unsaved indication, retry same receipt.
load_dead: show same death page with same pending_death, no ordinary world avatar spawned and no new failure/reward; must explicitly respawn. No automatic activeHP=1/full fix.
respawn: choose only the explicitly validated death context: ordinary death uses story_workcamp_start; registered training-room death uses its persisted training_gate_choice and explicit selected option owned by 修炼之门.v1.json. Preflight exact destination scene/pose/navigation/collision before changing life. Atomically pose+active+pending_death null+HP/mana/stamina at current validated maxima, special resources per14respawn rule, cooldowns unchanged. Append respawn receipt referencing same deathEvent; duplicate command returns original/no new heal.
respawn_fail: unresolved/blocked destination or save journal failure keeps awaiting_respawn, never choose nearest valid point or another map. File save after successful business commit failure keeps original committed memory+unsaved semantics.
activity: death failure closes current combat snapshot according to owner, retains attempts/fees/consumed resource/unique settlement. Pending loot from a different previously won encounter retained. LAN multiparty failure/exit follows activity contract, not room-wide reset.
configuration: 18center may explicitly modify life/HP together with linked activity/receipt preview, mark configured; normal HP heal of dead record cannot bypass life transition or count as resurrection skill.

training_gate_choice.required_when: death location is exactly one registered training room and no unrelated private activity
training_gate_choice.reject: missing/mismatched context or invalid pose; never infer room mode from a display name

scope: supports new schema5 one-role life component plus explicit training-room death choices; not whole-profile schema/runtime export. Future actual resurrection ability needs separate explicit cost/state transition, not regular healing.
